descriptionHtml:
Decision D4 · P0 · Vikram

Extraction rules vs UAT: should conditional and monitoring orders create tasks (UAT and TFA-92592 AC3 say yes, the prompt excludes them); should 'continue X' create a tracker row; the ported prompt lost 'continue X is a status, not a task'; Nursing Home dictation uses the Hospital vocabulary hint

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-19/S20, TC-22/S25, TC-23/S23

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S07 Statement kind × outcome: result, result pending or scheduled, unrelated result, conditional, monitoring, retraction, continue, restated open task, delegated

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Open tasks 'Follow up BMP' and 'Recheck weight in two weeks' (R rows) or 'Follow up BMP' and 'PT eval' (B rows); one statement per run so each cell is judged alone

When Save & Extract with each row's single sentence, in each listed context

Then R1 closes BMP only; R2 changes nothing; R3 adds one conditional task with its condition; R4H/R4H2/R4N add a monitoring task; R5 (retraction) and R6 (continue) add nothing; R8 (restates the open weight task) closes and adds nothing and leaves one weight task; B1 (drawn, pending) and B2 (scheduled) close and add nothing; B3 closes BMP only; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Each cell from U2/U3/U4/U5/U6/U7. R4 cells are the UAT's 'monitoring-phrased physician orders' as read here (Q2) and conflict with Vikram's prompt (Q1); they stay single decision-table cells, the 9/10 for U7 is in S04/S05. R8 is Q5 (d). B rows (formerly S08) are the done / not-done line: a result not yet in never closes. …

Where it ran: local aicheck-other (AI output checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Vikram.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Vikram) · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress

Dictating a conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') or a monitoring order ('trend the troponin every 6 hours') creates no task, because Vikram's task prompt deliberately excludes them while the UAT and TFA-92592 AC 3 expect one.

Evidence: allure-results/22853708…: 29 extractTasks cells: 17 pass, 6 fail, 6 record-only, reproduced on rerun. R3 (diet conditional) and R4 (monitoring orders) make no task because tasks/system.md v1.1 (identical to p72) excludes them. That is TC-22 Q1/Q2 and conflicts with TFA-92592 AC 3, so it goes to Vikram's prompt batch. B4b 'PT saw her, walking with a walker' dictated alone does not close 'PT eval', but it does close it inside the full UAT dictation (Q8).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-other.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-other.

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

New local lane aicheck-other: status failed in aicheck-other/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (aicheck-other/plan.json, automatable: yes): extract-ai runner: one fresh account; each row x each listed mode = one ai/parsing:extractTasks call (29) with the client's exact args (Hospital useEncounterTasks.ts: content = stripCodewordTasks(text), variant 'encounter'; Nursing Home useSaveAndExtract.ts: same + substring(0,1200)), then the client's merge (completed ids -> done, extractCodewordTasks + mergeTasksDedup). Checks closes/staysOpen/closesNothing/addsNothing/newTask{match,keeps}/noDuplicates/recordOnly/knownGap. Diagnostics row read after each call. extractMedicationEvents is NOT fired in S07 (only S19 times it); each cell records that no medication row appeared. Cells that conflict with the prompt whitelist (R3 diet, R4 monitoring) are labelled Q1/Q2 and routed to Vikram's prompt batch; they still fail against the UAT. — Pure server action + importable client merge.

Detail:

29 cells (one extractTasks call each, the clients' own args and merge): 17 pass, 6 fail, 6 record-only. Fails, all reproduced in a second run (R3 a third time after the review, 2 calls, no medication call): R3 'Advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4.' adds no task (Hospital and Nursing Home) - labelled Q1: a diet order is outside the prompt's whitelist (tasks/system.md v1.1 allows only consult / medication / imaging / labs, the JSON schema enum has no diet category, and it excludes 'future conditional considerations'); conditionals inside whitelisted categories ARE extracted (S19: H-02 furosemide, H-03 MRI, H-05 oxygen, N-02 oxycodone, N-03 blood cultures, N-05 neurology consult), so this is the UAT-vs-Vikram-prompt conflict, not a random miss -> Vikram's prompt batch. R4H 'Trend the troponin every 6 hours until it peaks.' and R4N 'Monitor her blood pressure twice daily this week and call me if the systolic is over 160.' add no task - Q1/Q2 (the prompt excludes 'monitoring/trending instructions'); context-dependent: the same troponin sentence inside S19 H-02's fuller dictation became the task 'Trend the troponin every 6 hours until it peaks'. B4b 'PT saw her, walking with a walker.' dictated alone leaves 'PT eval' open (both contexts) - context-dependent: in the UAT's own full dictation (S19 H-01, N-01) PT closes. Pass: R1, B3 close BMP only; R2, R5, R6, R8, B1, B2 change nothing; R4H2 adds 'recheck potassium this afternoon'. Record-only values: R7 (nursing fingersticks), B4 'PT saw her.', B5 'Creatinine 1.1 this morning.' close and add nothing. The raw model JSON was empty for every failing cell (no client-side filter dropped anything). Bounded calls: the first two S07 runs also fired extractMedicationEvents in parallel on every Hospital cell (~18 calls S07 never judges); extract-ai.ts now fires it in S19 only (re-run: 0 medication calls).

Product issue: Decision-table cells, one sentence dictated alone, reproducible (2/2 here, R3 3/3; 3/3 in the review's re-run): 'PT saw her, walking with a walker.' does not close 'PT eval', and 'Trend the troponin every 6 hours until it peaks.' / 'Monitor her blood pressure twice daily…' make no task. The result depends on context: inside a fuller dictation the troponin sentence does become a task (S19 H-02), and in the UAT's own TC-22 dictation PT closes (S19 H-01, N-01) while 'BMP came back' leaves BMP open in Hospital (UAT known gap, Q7). Not a defect to file separately: R3 (no diet task) and R4 (monitoring) are the UAT-vs-prompt conflict (Q1, Q2) for Vikram's prompt batch.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (extract-ai, not built): one fresh chart per cell, 29 calls.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
